title: Review sql string build
why: Dynamically constructed SQL can mix untrusted values into executable query text.
suggestion: Bind data values as parameters; use an explicit noqa S608 review when trusted identifiers must be interpolated.
limitations: Only string literals that begin with a SQL statement are considered; natural-language messages are ignored, including prompts that begin with `Select from` but have no projection.
An S608 noqa directive suppresses the complete continued SQL expression containing it.
